bead.title: claude-tui: capability baseline row, evidence IDs, and ADR-013 promotion gate
bead.description:
PROBLEM: Without empirical billing-observation evidence and machine-checkable capability evidence IDs, ADR-013 cannot be promoted from re-proposed to accepted, and the primary capability baseline lacks a claude-tui row. CI currently does not fail when a supported capability row lacks an evidence ID, so promotion is unenforced.

ROOT CAUSE:
- docs/.../primary-harness-capability-baseline.md has no claude-tui row, so per-ADR-002 promotion cannot occur.
- The machine-checkable capability matrix (fizeau-3b1fb0f4) has no evidence-ID column wiring for claude-tui rows.
- ADR-013 explicitly conditions its promotion on empirical evidence that subscription billing is observed off the CLI session, not API metering; no such cassette is recorded yet.
- CI has no check that fails when a row marked supported lacks an evidence ID, so silent promotion is possible.

PROPOSED FIX:
1. Add a claude-tui row to docs/.../primary-harness-capability-baseline.md initially marked unverified for all capabilities introduced by children #2 and #3.
2. Record a live billing-observation cassette under testdata/ that demonstrates subscription-mode billing is read off the CLI session (not via API metering); cite cassette ID.
3. Extend the machine-checkable capability matrix tooling (cross-ref fizeau-3b1fb0f4) so each supported claude-tui row carries an evidence_id field; add CI assertion that fails when a row marked supported has no evidence_id.
4. Promote only those rows whose evidence cassettes exist; leave the rest unverified.
5. Flip ADR-013 frontmatter status from re-proposed to accepted and record the billing-observation evidence ID inline.

NON-SCOPE:
- Adding new harness capabilities beyond those already evidenced by children #2 and #3.
- Reworking the capability matrix schema (only adding the evidence_id wiring and CI gate).
- Promoting any capability row that lacks a current cassette.
- Generalizing the evidence_id gate to other harnesses in this bead (scoped to claude-tui rows).

Depends on children #1, #2, #3. Governing artifacts: ADR-002 (capability promotion), ADR-013 (promotion gate), fizeau-3b1fb0f4 (machine-checkable matrix), CONTRACT-004.
bead.acceptance:
1) TestPrimaryHarnessCapabilityBaselineHasClaudeTuiRow asserts the markdown file contains a claude-tui row with at least one entry per ADR-002 row schema.
2) TestClaudeTuiBillingObservationEvidenceCassette asserts the recorded billing-observation cassette is loadable, parses to a subscription-mode billing signal, and is referenced from ADR-013 frontmatter by its evidence ID.
3) TestCapabilityMatrixEvidenceIDRequired asserts the matrix CI gate fails when any claude-tui row marked supported has an empty evidence_id, and passes when all supported rows cite a present cassette.
4) TestClaudeTuiRowsPromotedOnlyWithEvidence asserts every row currently marked supported for claude-tui resolves to a present cassette file on disk.
5) TestADR013StatusAccepted asserts the ADR-013 frontmatter status field equals "accepted" and references the billing-observation evidence ID from AC2.
6) go test ./... -count=1 is green.
7) lefthook run pre-commit is green.
